chunks: “He should walk during the prayer by dragging his feet and not stepping over.”

key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the ritual act in which this movement occurs
key_terms.يَتَخَطَّى: he steps over or takes large steps
key_terms.يَجُرُّ: he drags, meaning he moves without lifting the feet prominently
key_terms.يَمْشِي: he walks or moves on foot

ai.seo_question: How should a person walk if movement is needed during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning movement during salat (prayer). It indicates that when walking in prayer, one should move with small, dragging steps and avoid stepping over in a pronounced manner.
